title: Pearl Mining Profit Calculator
subtitle: Dynamic Interactive | Hashrate Decoupling | Auto Cache | Bleeding Alert
tipDailyCoinOutput: Daily PRL output = Total Hashrate × Yield × 24h × (1 − Fee). Before electricity cost.
effSingleCard: Metrics below are based on single GPU parameters only, independent of GPU count.
tipDailyElecCost:
Total Power(kW) × 24h × Electricity Price

Formula: Daily kWh × Price per kWh
tipDailyGross:
Total Hashrate × Yield per TH × 24h × (1−Pool Fee) × Coin Price

Total fiat value of daily PRL output.
tipDailyCoinOutput:
Total Hashrate × Yield per TH × 24h × (1−Pool Fee)

Daily PRL mined, before electricity cost.
tipDailyNet:
Daily Gross − Daily Electricity Cost

Positive = profit, Negative = loss.
tipCostRatio:
Daily Electricity ÷ Daily Gross × 100%

Higher ratio means thinner margin. Over 100% = operating at a loss.
fullPaybackDesc: Death hold strategy: Earn back total investment through mining only.
residualPaybackDesc: Defense strategy: Mining covers total depreciation exposure.
bleedingMessage: The array is in bleeding state. Daily mining output has been penetrated by high electricity costs. Immediate shutdown is recommended to stop losses.
footer: Professional GPU Mining Analysis & Arbitrage Tool. Version 2.0.0
disclaimer: All calculations are based on currently available real-time data and are for reference only. Actual results may vary due to network difficulty fluctuations, price volatility, and other factors.
tipCostEff: Hashrate per unit of currency spent. Higher = better value. Formula: GPU Hashrate ÷ Card Price
tipPowerEff: Hashrate per watt of power consumed. Higher = more energy efficient. Formula: GPU Hashrate ÷ Power Consumption
tipShutdownPrice: When coin price drops to this level, daily output equals daily electricity cost — zero profit. Below this price, mining operates at a loss.
tipDailyROI: Daily Net Profit ÷ Total Investment × 100%. Shows the percentage return on each dollar invested per day.
tipAnnualizedROI: Daily ROI × 365 (simple interest). Annualized return for comparison with bank deposits, funds, etc.
tipYearlyROI: (Annual Net − Depreciation) ÷ Total Investment × 100%. Actual annual return after accounting for equipment residual value.
tipProfitMultiple: Annual Net Profit ÷ Total Investment. How many dollars earned per dollar invested in one year. 1.0x = break-even in 1 year.
priceTrendDesc: PRL/USDT price movement over the last 24 hours
tipNetworkHashrate: Current total hashrate of the Pearl network, reflecting the computing power of all miners.
tipDailyGlobalOutput: Estimated total daily PRL output based on current block reward and block time.
tipAvgBlockTime: Average block interval (Time To Find) of the current network.
